entities.name: Cathedral of the Descent of the Holy Spirit, Lugoj

entities.summary: The Cathedral of the Descent of the Holy Spirit also called Greek Catholic Cathedral of the Descent of the Holy Spirit is the name given to a Catholic religious building of the Romanian or Byzantine rite that serves as the seat of the Eparchy of Lugoj which was created in 1853 with the Bull "Apostolicum ministerium" of Pope Pius IX is located in Lugoj, originally in the Austrian Empire and now in Romania.
